findings.issue: THE DEFAULT-LOGICAL ORACLE WAS VACUOUS. It asserted KIND(observed) - KIND(.FALSE.) == 0, but observed is declared LOGICAL with no kind selector, so its kind is default BY DECLARATION. The oracle observed the VARIABLE, never the kind of the expression left < right. The test would pass even if the relational operation produced a non-default logical result, because assignment into observed would convert it.
findings.principle: An oracle must observe the EXPRESSION, not a variable that launders it. The assertion was true for a reason unrelated to the requirement.
findings.closure: Closed in a01aecf. The author chose to WITHDRAW the facet to pending rather than fabricate an oracle, recording that a future fixture must assert KIND(left < right) == KIND(.FALSE.) directly with a portable load-bearing non-default-kind mutation. Facet count accordingly fell from +13 to +12.
findings.integrator_note: Withdrawal was explicitly offered as an acceptable outcome. A smaller honest packet beats a larger one carrying a vacuous oracle, and kinds are processor dependent so a load-bearing non-default-kind mutation may not be portably constructible here.

findings.issue: LEN(left) and LEN(same) were asserted but NOT LEN(different), before the false control left == different. The claim that every character length was asserted was overstated.
findings.why_it_matters: Character comparison blank-pads the shorter operand, so an unasserted length is exactly how a padding assumption slips through unnoticed.
findings.closure: Closed in a01aecf; LEN(different) == 2 guard added and covered by a mutation the reviewer re-ran directly.

findings.issue: WRONG-OPERATOR VACUITY. Four fixtures still passed when the relational operator was replaced by a DIFFERENT relational operator: < to <=, .LT. to .LE., == to <=, and /= to > all PASSED on both toolchains.
findings.root_cause: The operand pairs never exercised the rows where the operators differ. < and <= differ ONLY on equality; == and <= differ only when the left operand is less than the right; /= and > likewise. The chosen operands (-4,3) and (3,-4) and (7,7) and (7,-2) simply never hit those rows.
findings.why_the_campaign_missed_it: The author's 179-mutation campaign corrupted oracles, inputs and observations. A wrong-operator implementation survives all of them, because the oracle and the operator are wrong together consistently. Only substituting the OPERATOR UNDER TEST exposes it.
findings.closure: Closed in 345ca75. All six spelling-pair fixtures now assert three common rows - less (-4,3), equal (5,5), greater (8,1) - for both dotted and symbolic spellings on identical named operands.
findings.why_the_fix_is_sound: Those three rows give six truth-signatures: < is TFF, <= is TTF, > is FFT, >= is FTT, == is FTF, /= is TFT. All six are DISTINCT, so the three rows uniquely determine every operator. The integrator verified this discrimination independently and found NO collisions.
findings.reviewer_verification: The reviewer re-ran ALL 60 permanent substitutions: 120/120 compiler runs FAILED as required. The four original survivors now fail - < to <= and .LT. to .LE. at the equal row, == to <= and /= to > at the less row.
findings.permanent_remedy: 60 wrong-operator substitutions (30 operator/alternative pairs across dotted and symbolic spellings) are now PERMANENT in the generator via OPERATOR_ORDER, TRUTH_TABLE, DISCRIMINATION_ROWS and emitted wrong-operator-substitution probes.

findings.issue: The reviewer flagged that --audit reports catalogue_reviews[10.1.5.5.1] as stale and treated it as a packet defect.

The stale state is the expected intermediate condition, resolved by the integrator in the same commit that integrates the packet - as done here and for the sibling 10.1.4 and 10.1.5.1 packets.
findings.action_taken: No author action. Recorded so the expectation is unambiguous for future fixture packets.

non_vacuity_by_mutation.principle: Non-vacuity must be proved by MUTATION, not by inspection - and the mutation must target the FEATURE UNDER TEST, not merely its oracle.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.final_campaign: 263 mutations x 2 compilers, all failing: 60 wrong-operator substitutions, 45 logical flips, 20 select-case flips, 18 .NEQV. sentinel reversals, 83 omissions, plus completion, operand and blank-padding mutations.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.reviewer_reran: All 60 wrong-operator substitutions, 120/120 failing across both toolchains.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.systemic_finding: This is the SECOND packet in the same checkpoint to carry wrong-operator vacuity; the other was 10.1.5.1 (batch127). Two of three fixture packets shipped it. The defect class is systemic to fixture work in this project, not an individual slip.

source_derivations_independently_confirm.blank_padding_rule: 10.1.5.5.1 p8: the SHORTER operand is extended on the right with blanks to the length of the LONGER operand.
source_derivations_independently_confirm.case_A_vs_A_blank: 'A' (len 1) vs 'A ' (len 2): shorter becomes 'A ', all corresponding characters equal, so == is TRUE.
source_derivations_independently_confirm.case_A_vs_A_blank_blank_B: 'A' (len 1) vs 'A  B' (len 4): shorter becomes 'A   '. Positions 1-3 match; position 4 is blank versus B, so == is FALSE and /= is TRUE. No collation-order oracle is needed.
source_derivations_independently_confirm.zero_length: p8 states EXPLICITLY that if both operands are of zero length they are equal. This is source-supported, NOT an assumption - the reviewer confirmed the text.
source_derivations_independently_confirm.len_discipline: LEN is asserted explicitly in every character fixture, because character comparison blank-pads the shorter operand.
